title: mri_glmfit
description: Performs general linear model (GLM) analysis in the volume or the surface.

glmdir.description: Directory where output will be saved.
glmdir.title: GLM output directory

y_input.description: Path to input file where each frame is a separate input. Accepts volume or surface-based formats.
y_input.title: Input file

table_input.description: Use text table as input instead of --y. Table should be of form produced by asegstats2table or aparcstats2table.
table_input.title: Stats table

fsgd.description: Specify the global design matrix with a FreeSurfer Group Descriptor File (FSGDF).
fsgd.title: FSGD descriptor file

design_matrix.description: Explicitly specify the design matrix. Can be in simple text or in matlab4 format.
design_matrix.title: Design matrix file

contrast_matrix.description: Specify one or more contrasts to test. File should be ASCII text with the contrast matrix.
contrast_matrix.title: Contrast matrix file

osgm_flag.description: Construct X and C as a one-sample group mean.
osgm_flag.title: One-sample group mean

no_contrasts_ok_flag.description: Do not fail if no contrasts are specified.
no_contrasts_ok_flag.title: No contrasts OK flag

dti_params.description: Do DTI analysis using bvals and bvecs.
dti_params.title: DTI parameters

dti_matrix.description: Do DTI analysis using provided matrix.
dti_matrix.title: DTI design matrix

selfreg.description: Create a 'self-regressor' from the input data based on the waveform at index col row slice.
selfreg.title: Self-regressor coordinates

wls.description: Perform weighted least squares (WLS) random effects analysis instead of ordinary least squares (OLS) using yffxvar.
wls.title: Weighted least squares

ffxdof.description: Degrees of Freedom (DOF) for fixed effects analysis.
ffxdof.title: Fixed effects DOF

ffxdofdat.description: Text file with DOF for fixed effects analysis.
ffxdofdat.title: Fixed effects DOF data

weight.description: Perform weighted LMS using per-voxel weights from the weightfile.
weight.title: Weight file

fwhm.description: Smooth input with a Gaussian kernel, specified in mm.
fwhm.title: Smoothing kernel FWHM

var_fwhm.description: Smooth residual variance map with a Gaussian kernel, specified in mm.
var_fwhm.title: Variance smoothing FWHM

label.description: Use label as mask for surface data.
label.title: Label file

no_mask_flag.description: Do NOT use a mask, same as --no-cortex.
no_mask_flag.title: No mask flag

prune_flag.description: Remove voxels that do not have a non-zero value at each frame.
prune_flag.title: Prune zero-value voxels

logy_flag.description: Compute natural log of y prior to analysis.
logy_flag.title: Log transform y

no_logy_flag.description: Do not compute natural log of y prior to analysis.
no_logy_flag.title: No log transform of y

rm_spatial_mean_flag.description: Subtract the (masked) mean from each frame.
rm_spatial_mean_flag.title: Remove spatial mean

eres_scm_flag.description: Save residual error spatial correlation matrix (eres.scm).
eres_scm_flag.title: Save residual SCM

save_fwhm_map_flag.description: Save voxel-wise map of FWHM estimates.
save_fwhm_map_flag.title: Save FWHM map

surface.description: Specify that the input has a surface geometry from the hemisphere of the given FreeSurfer subject. Required for surface data operations.
surface.title: Surface specification

skew_flag.description: Compute skew and p-value for skew.
skew_flag.title: Compute skewness

kurtosis_flag.description: Compute kurtosis and p-value for kurtosis.
kurtosis_flag.title: Compute kurtosis

sim_params.description: Simulate data for statistical testing. Specify nulltype, number of simulations, threshold and csd basename.
sim_params.title: Simulation parameters

sim_sign.description: Specify sign for simulation: abs, pos, or neg.
sim_sign.title: Simulation sign

uniform_params.description: Use uniform distribution for mc-full, specify min and max.
uniform_params.title: Uniform distribution parameters

permute_input_flag.description: Permute input for testing purposes (not related to simulation).
permute_input_flag.title: Permute input flag

pca_flag.description: Perform PCA/SVD analysis on the residual.
pca_flag.title: Perform PCA

tar1_flag.description: Compute and save temporal AR1 of residual.
tar1_flag.title: Compute temporal AR1

save_yhat_flag.description: Flag to save the signal estimate.
save_yhat_flag.title: Save signal estimate flag

save_cond_flag.description: Flag to save design matrix condition at each voxel.
save_cond_flag.title: Save condition number

voxdump.description: Save GLM data for a single voxel at the specified col, row, slice.
voxdump.title: Voxel dump coordinates

seed.description: Use seed for random number generation.
seed.title: Random seed

synth_flag.description: Replace input data with Gaussian noise for testing.
synth_flag.title: Synthesize Gaussian noise

resynthtest_it.description: Test GLM by resynthsis with the number of iterations specified.
resynthtest_it.title: Resynthesis test iterations

profile_it.description: Test speed with specified number of iterations.
profile_it.title: Profile iterations

mrtm1_params.description: Perform MRTM1 kinetic modeling with specified reference tissue activity and time in seconds.
mrtm1_params.title: MRTM1 parameters

mrtm2_params.description: Perform MRTM2 kinetic modeling with specified parameters.
mrtm2_params.title: MRTM2 parameters

logan_params.description: Perform Logan kinetic modeling with specified parameters.
logan_params.title: Logan model parameters

bp_clip_max.description: Set BP voxels above max to max.
bp_clip_max.title: Max value for BP clipping

perm_force_flag.description: Force permutation test, even when design matrix is not orthogonal.
perm_force_flag.title: Force permutation test

diag_cluster_flag.description: Save significant volume and exit from first simulation loop.
diag_cluster_flag.title: Cluster diagnostic

checkopts_flag.description: Check options and exit without executing.
checkopts_flag.title: Check options only

no_fix_vertex_area_flag.description: Turn off fixing of vertex area (backward compatibility).
no_fix_vertex_area_flag.title: No fix vertex area

allowsubjrep_flag.description: Allow subject names to repeat in the fsgd file.
allowsubjrep_flag.title: Allow subject repetition

allow_zero_dof_flag.description: Allow analyses with zero degrees of freedom.
allow_zero_dof_flag.title: Allow zero DOF

sim_done_file.description: Create done file when simulation finishes.
sim_done_file.title: Simulation done file

no_sig_double_flag.description: Compute sig = -log10(p) from float p value, not double.
no_sig_double_flag.title: No double precision
